decision: The exact v4.1 schema identity and successful producer workflow are now bound as candidate authority evidence for all 16 MBS utilisation objects; publication and token-free anonymous restore receipts remain unbound candidate evidence for 14 of 16 paths. Authority is not yet referenced by complete v4 contracts. Two August paths, source semantics, discovery, recovery/cache, and consumers remain incomplete. Official source temporal semantics are qualified for 13 utilisation objects; their native schema layouts and three source-role candidates remain unresolved. Location and discovery evidence now cover all 16 paths but remain unbound until referenced by complete per-object v4 contracts. V3 replay evidence is candidate-only for 6 of 16 objects. Recovery evidence covers only the 14 utilisation paths; hosted cache-cleanup candidates bind 6 of 16 paths. Consumer cache behavior remains a post-admission check. Current independently evidenced state is 5 v4 admissions and 5 admitted-object consumer canaries; this candidate-role refresh performed no admission or canary.
